scientific_integrity: The source marginal-set identification is credited; new work consists of the exact defect census, sharp minimum, equality rigidity and matrix-population formulas. Finite checks supplement an all-parameter symbolic proof.
scientific_limitations: For finite nonzero Rees sandwich matrices and ordered products of marginal elements only; establishes the zero and first positive strata, not all defect levels or semigroup-isomorphism counts. Historical priority is provisional; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp first closure-defect stratum for Rees commutator margins
